caption:
Midday: chips have won back only about 25% of Thursday's loss, down from about 45% at 10:01 AM (StockTitan).

Nasdaq +1.0%, S&P 500 +0.5%, Dow -0.2% at 12:50 PM ET (CNBC), after the Nasdaq was +1.9% at 9:52 AM. Consumer sentiment came in at 51.0 vs 47.5 expected.

Swipe for the hour-by-hour chip chart and midday movers.

Is the chip bounce fading or just pausing? Tell us below.

Send this to a friend who trades. Closing update around 4:15 PM ET.

Intraday moves can reverse. Sources on the last slide. Educational content only. Not financial advice. Trading involves risk of loss.
